description: Docker Compose full-stack integration, Dockerfiles for frontend and backend, environment configuration, and final README documentation.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/Dockerfile - Multi-stage build: build stage with npm ci + tsc, production stage with node:22-alpine running the compiled JS.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/frontend/Dockerfile - Multi-stage build: build stage with npm ci + next build, production stage with next start.

Update /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/docker-compose.yml to include backend and frontend services alongside PostgreSQL, Redis, Meilisearch. Add depends_on, health checks, proper networking, environment variable pass-through.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/.env.example with all environment variables documented (DB connection, Redis URL, JWT secret, Google OAuth credentials, AI provider API keys for OpenAI/Anthropic/Groq/Ollama, S3 config, Meilisearch key).

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/README.md - Comprehensive documentation: what Craq is, features, tech stack, setup instructions (Docker Compose and local dev), environment variables guide, API documentation overview, project structure, AI configuration guide for multiple providers.
Verify: docker compose config validates the compose file, and docker build succeeds for both backend and frontend Dockerfiles.
acceptance_criteria: Docker Compose file orchestrates all services (postgres, redis, meilisearch, backend, frontend)
README.md documents setup, configuration, and usage
All environment variables are documented in .env.example
AI provider configuration is clearly documented for all supported providers
findings: docker compose CLI plugin not available in sandbox (podman-based container runtime), but YAML validation and individual docker builds succeed. Backend uses port 4000 (not 3001 as originally suggested). Added output: standalone to next.config.js for frontend Docker build.
